1.english_reference: And the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et factus est sermo Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: And the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

2.english_reference: Son of man , prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy ,

traditions.WLC: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הִנָּבֵ֛א אֶל נְבִיאֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַ נִּבָּאִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: Υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου , προφήτευσον ἐπὶ τοὺς προφήτας τοῦ Ἰσραήλ , καὶ προφητεύσεις
traditions.VUL: Fili hóminis , vaticináre ad prophétas Israel , qui prophétant :
traditions.KJV: Son of man , prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy ,

2.english_reference: and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לִ נְבִיאֵ֣י מִ לִּבָּ֔ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς
traditions.VUL: et dices prophetántibus de corde suo :
traditions.KJV: and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts ,

2.english_reference: Hear ye the word of the LORD ;

traditions.WLC: שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: Ἀκούσατε λόγον Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: Audíte verbum Dómini .
traditions.KJV: Hear ye the word of the LORD ;

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the Lord GOD ;

traditions.WLC: ה֖וֹי עַל הַ נְּבִיאִ֣ים הַ נְּבָלִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: Οὐαὶ τοῖς προφητεύουσιν ἀπὸ καρδίας αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Væ prophétis insipiéntibus ,
traditions.KJV: Woe unto the foolish prophets ,

3.english_reference: that follow their own spirit , and have seen nothing !

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֹלְכִ֛ים אַחַ֥ר רוּחָ֖ ם וּ לְ בִלְתִּ֥י רָאֽוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ καθόλου μὴ βλέπουσιν .
traditions.VUL: qui sequúntur spíritum suum , et nihil vident .
traditions.KJV: that follow their own spirit , and have seen nothing !

4.english_reference: O Israel , thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts .

traditions.WLC: כְּ שֻׁעָלִ֖ים בָּ חֳרָב֑וֹת נְבִיאֶ֥י ךָ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הָיֽוּ
traditions.LXX: ὡς ἀλώπεκες ἐν ταῖς ἐρήμοις οἱ προφῆταί σου , Ἰσραήλ ·
traditions.VUL: Quasi vulpes in desértis , prophétæ tui Israel erant .
traditions.KJV: O Israel , thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts .

5.english_reference: Ye have not gone up into the gaps ,

traditions.WLC: לֹ֤א עֲלִיתֶם֙ בַּ פְּרָצ֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: οὐκ ἔστησαν ἐν στερεώματι
traditions.VUL: Non ascendístis ex advérso ,
traditions.KJV: Ye have not gone up into the gaps ,

5.english_reference: neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּגְדְּר֥וּ גָדֵ֖ר עַל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνήγαγον ποίμνια ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: neque opposuístis murum pro domo Israel ,
traditions.KJV: neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel

5.english_reference: to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD .

traditions.WLC: לַ עֲמֹ֥ד בַּ מִּלְחָמָ֖ה בְּ י֥וֹם יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: οὐκ ἀνέστησαν οἱ λέγοντες Ἐν ἡμέρᾳ Κυρίου ·
traditions.VUL: ut starétis in prœ́lio in die Dómini .
traditions.KJV: to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD .

6.english_reference: They have seen vanity and lying divination ,

traditions.WLC: חָ֤זוּ שָׁוְא֙ וְ קֶ֣סֶם כָּזָ֔ב
traditions.LXX: βλέποντες ψευδῆ , μαντευόμενοι μάταια ,
traditions.VUL: Vident vana , et divínant mendácium ,
traditions.KJV: They have seen vanity and lying divination ,

traditions.WLC: הָ אֹֽמְרִים֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: οἱ λέγοντες Λέγει Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: dicéntes : Ait Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: saying , The LORD saith :

6.english_reference: and the LORD hath not sent them :

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א שְׁלָחָ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ Κύριος οὐκ ἀπέσταλκεν αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: cum Dóminus non míserit eos :
traditions.KJV: and the LORD hath not sent them :

6.english_reference: and they have made [ others ] to hope that they would confirm the word .

traditions.WLC: וְ יִֽחֲל֖וּ לְ קַיֵּ֥ם דָּבָֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤρξαντο τοῦ ἀναστῆσαι λόγον .
traditions.VUL: et perseveravérunt confirmáre sermónem .
traditions.KJV: and they have made [ others ] to hope that they would confirm the word .

7.english_reference: Have ye not seen a vain vision , and have ye not spoken a lying divination ,

traditions.WLC: הֲ ל֤וֹא מַֽחֲזֵה שָׁוְא֙ חֲזִיתֶ֔ם וּ מִקְסַ֥ם כָּזָ֖ב אֲמַרְתֶּ֑ם
traditions.LXX: οὐχ ὅρασιν ψευδῆ ἑωράκατε , καὶ μαντείας ματαίας εἰρήκατε ;
traditions.VUL: Numquid non visiónem cassam vidístis , et divinatiónem mendácem locúti estis ,
traditions.KJV: Have ye not seen a vain vision , and have ye not spoken a lying divination ,

7.english_reference: whereas ye say , The LORD saith [ it ] ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אֹֽמְרִים֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: et dícitis : Ait Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: whereas ye say , The LORD saith [ it ] ;

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲנִ֖י לֹ֥א דִבַּֽרְתִּי
traditions.VUL: cum ego non sim locútus ?
traditions.KJV: albeit I have not spoken ?

8.english_reference: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ;

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Διὰ τοῦτο εἰπόν Τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Proptérea hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ;

8.english_reference: Because ye have spoken vanity , and seen lies ,

traditions.WLC: יַ֚עַן דַּבֶּרְ כֶ֣ם שָׁ֔וְא וַ חֲזִיתֶ֖ם כָּזָ֑ב
traditions.LXX: Ἀνθ᾽ ὧν οἱ λόγοι ὑμῶν ψευδεῖς καὶ αἱ μαντεῖαι ὑμῶν μάταιαι ,
traditions.VUL: Quia locúti estis vana , et vidístis mendácium :
traditions.KJV: Because ye have spoken vanity , and seen lies ,

8.english_reference: therefore , behold , I [ am ] against you , saith the Lord GOD .

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵן֙ הִנְ נִ֣י אֲלֵי כֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥ י יְהוִֽה
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς , λέγει Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: ídeo ecce ego ad vos , dicit Dóminus Deus .
traditions.KJV: therefore , behold , I [ am ] against you , saith the Lord GOD .

9.english_reference: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity , and that divine lies :

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיְתָ֣ה יָדִ֗ י אֶֽל הַ נְּבִיאִ֞ים הַ חֹזִ֣ים שָׁוְא֮ וְ הַ קֹּסְמִ֣ים כָּזָב֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκτενῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπὶ τοὺς προφήτας τοὺς ὁρῶντας ψευδῆ καὶ τοὺς ἀποφθεγγομένους μάταια ·
traditions.VUL: Et erit manus mea super prophétas , qui vident vana , et divínant mendácium :
traditions.KJV: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity , and that divine lies :

9.english_reference: they shall not be in the assembly of my people ,

traditions.WLC: בְּ ס֧וֹד עַמִּ֣ י לֹֽא יִהְי֗וּ
traditions.LXX: ἐν παιδείᾳ τοῦ λαοῦ μου οὐκ ἔσονται ,
traditions.VUL: in consílio pópuli mei non erunt ,
traditions.KJV: they shall not be in the assembly of my people ,

9.english_reference: neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: וּ בִ כְתָ֤ב בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֹ֣א יִכָּתֵ֔בוּ
traditions.LXX: οὐδὲ ἐν γραφῇ οἴκου Ἰσραὴλ οὐ γραφήσονται ,
traditions.VUL: et in scriptúra domus Israel non scribéntur ,
traditions.KJV: neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel ,

9.english_reference: neither shall they enter into the land of Israel ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶל אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֣א יָבֹ֑אוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰς τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ οὐκ εἰσελεύσονται ·
traditions.VUL: nec in terram Israel ingrediéntur :
traditions.KJV: neither shall they enter into the land of Israel ;

9.english_reference: and ye shall know that I [ am ] the Lord GOD .

traditions.WLC: וִ ידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥ י יְהוִֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ γνώσονται διότι ἐγὼ Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: et sciétis quia ego Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: and ye shall know that I [ am ] the Lord GOD .

10.english_reference: Because , even because they have seduced my people ,

traditions.WLC: יַ֣עַן וּ בְ יַ֜עַן הִטְע֧וּ אֶת עַמִּ֛ י
traditions.LXX: ἀνθ᾽ ὧν τὸν λαόν μου ἐπλάνησαν ,
traditions.VUL: eo quod decéperint pópulum meum ,
traditions.KJV: Because , even because they have seduced my people ,

10.english_reference: saying , Peace ; and [ there was ] no peace ;

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֥ר שָׁל֖וֹם וְ אֵ֣ין שָׁל֑וֹם
traditions.LXX: λέγοντες Εἰρήνη , καὶ οὐκ ἦν εἰρήνη ·
traditions.VUL: dicéntes : Pax , et non est pax :
traditions.KJV: saying , Peace ; and [ there was ] no peace ;

10.english_reference: and one built up a wall ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הוּא֙ בֹּ֣נֶה חַ֔יִץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὗτος οἰκοδομεῖ τοῖχον ,
traditions.VUL: et ipse ædificábat paríetem ,
traditions.KJV: and one built up a wall ,

10.english_reference: and , lo , others daubed it with untempered [ morter ] :

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנָּ֛ ם טָחִ֥ים אֹת֖ וֹ תָּפֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ αὐτοὶ ἀλείφουσιν αὐτόν , πεσεῖται .
traditions.VUL: illi autem liniébant eum luto absque páleis .
traditions.KJV: and , lo , others daubed it with untempered [ morter ] :

11.english_reference: Say unto them which daub [ it ] with untempered [ morter ]

traditions.WLC: אֱמֹ֛ר אֶל טָחֵ֥י תָפֵ֖ל
traditions.LXX: εἰπὸν πρὸς τοὺς ἀλείφοντας
traditions.VUL: Dic ad eos , qui líniunt absque temperatúra ,
traditions.KJV: Say unto them which daub [ it ] with untempered [ morter ] ,

traditions.WLC: וְ יִפֹּ֑ל
traditions.LXX: Πεσεῖται ,
traditions.VUL: quod casúrus sit :
traditions.KJV: that it shall fall :

11.english_reference: there shall be an overflowing shower

traditions.WLC: הָיָ֣ה גֶּ֣שֶׁם שׁוֹטֵ֗ף
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ὑετὸς κατακλύζων ,
traditions.VUL: erit enim imber inúndans ,
traditions.KJV: there shall be an overflowing shower ;

11.english_reference: and ye , O great hailstones , shall fall

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתֵּ֜נָה אַבְנֵ֤י אֶלְגָּבִישׁ֙ תִּפֹּ֔לְנָה
traditions.LXX: καὶ δώσω λίθους πετροβόλους εἰς τοὺς ἐνδέσμους αὐτῶν , καὶ πεσοῦνται ,
traditions.VUL: et dabo lápides prægrándes désuper irruéntes ,
traditions.KJV: and ye , O great hailstones , shall fall ;

11.english_reference: and a stormy wind shall rend [ it ]

traditions.WLC: וְ ר֥וּחַ סְעָר֖וֹת תְּבַקֵּֽעַ
traditions.LXX: καὶ πνεῦμα ἐξαῖρον , καὶ ῥαγήσεται .
traditions.VUL: et ventum procéllæ dissipántem .
traditions.KJV: and a stormy wind shall rend [ it ] .

12.english_reference: Lo , when the wall is fallen

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנֵּ֖ה נָפַ֣ל הַ קִּ֑יר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἰδοὺ πέπτωκεν ὁ τοῖχος ,
traditions.VUL: Síquidem ecce cécidit páries :
traditions.KJV: Lo , when the wall is fallen ,

12.english_reference: shall it not be said unto you

traditions.WLC: הֲ לוֹא֙ יֵאָמֵ֣ר אֲלֵי כֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐροῦσιν πρὸς ὑμᾶς
traditions.VUL: numquid non dicétur vobis :
traditions.KJV: shall it not be said unto you ,

12.english_reference: Where [ is ] the daubing wherewith ye have daubed [ it ] ?

traditions.WLC: אַיֵּ֥ה הַ טִּ֖יחַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר טַחְתֶּֽם
traditions.LXX: Ποῦ ἐστιν ἡ ἀλοιφὴ ὑμῶν ἣν ἠλείψατε ;
traditions.VUL: Ubi est litúra quam linístis ?
traditions.KJV: Where [ is ] the daubing wherewith ye have daubed [ it ] ?

13.english_reference: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֔ה
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Proptérea hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ;

13.english_reference: I will even rend [ it ] with a stormy wind in my fury

traditions.WLC: וּ בִקַּעְתִּ֥י רֽוּחַ סְעָר֖וֹת בַּֽ חֲמָתִ֑ י
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ῥήξω πνοὴν ἐξαίρουσαν μετὰ θυμοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Et erúmpere fáciam spíritum tempestátum in indignatióne mea ,
traditions.KJV: I will even rend [ it ] with a stormy wind in my fury ;

13.english_reference: and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger

traditions.WLC: וְ גֶ֤שֶׁם שֹׁטֵף֙ בְּ אַפִּ֣ י יִֽהְיֶ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑετὸς κατακλύζων ἐν ὀργῇ μου ἔσται ,
traditions.VUL: et imber inúndans in furóre meo erit :
traditions.KJV: and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger ,

13.english_reference: and great hailstones in [ my ] fury to consume [ it ]

traditions.WLC: וְ אַבְנֵ֥י אֶלְגָּבִ֖ישׁ בְּ חֵמָ֥ה לְ כָלָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς λίθους τοὺς πετροβόλους ἐν θυμῷ ἐπάξω εἰς συντέλειαν ,
traditions.VUL: et lápides grandes in ira in consumptiónem .
traditions.KJV: and great hailstones in [ my ] fury to consume [ it ] .

14.english_reference: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered [ morter ]

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ֨רַסְתִּ֜י אֶת הַ קִּ֨יר אֲשֶׁר טַחְתֶּ֥ם תָּפֵ֛ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατασκάψω τὸν τοῖχον ὃν ἠλείψατε , πεσεῖται ·
traditions.VUL: Et déstruam paríetem , quem linístis absque temperaménto :
traditions.KJV: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered [ morter ] ,

14.english_reference: and bring it down to the ground

traditions.WLC: וְ הִגַּעְתִּ֥י הוּ אֶל הָ אָ֖רֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ θήσω αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν
traditions.VUL: et adæquábo eum terræ ,
traditions.KJV: and bring it down to the ground ,

14.english_reference: so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered

traditions.WLC: וְ נִגְלָ֣ה יְסֹד֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀποκαλυφθήσεται τὰ θεμέλια αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: et revelábitur fundaméntum eius :
traditions.KJV: so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered ,

traditions.WLC: וְ נָֽפְלָה֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ πεσεῖται
traditions.VUL: et cadet ,
traditions.KJV: and it shall fall ,

14.english_reference: and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof

traditions.WLC: וּ כְלִיתֶ֣ם בְּ תוֹכָ֔ הּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ συντελεσθήσεσθε μετ᾽ ἐλέγχων ·
traditions.VUL: et consumétur in médio eius :
traditions.KJV: and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof :

14.english_reference: and ye shall know that I [ am ] the LORD

traditions.WLC: וִֽ ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: et sciétis quia ego sum Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: and ye shall know that I [ am ] the LORD .

15.english_reference: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall

traditions.WLC: וְ כִלֵּיתִ֤י אֶת חֲמָתִ י֙ בַּ קִּ֔יר
traditions.LXX: καὶ συντελέσω τὸν θυμόν μου ἐπὶ τὸν τοῖχον
traditions.VUL: Et complébo indignatiónem meam in paríete ,
traditions.KJV: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall ,

15.english_reference: and upon them that have daubed it with untempered [ morter ]

traditions.WLC: וּ בַ טָּחִ֥ים אֹת֖ וֹ תָּפֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀλείφοντας αὐτόν , πεσεῖται .
traditions.VUL: et in his , qui líniunt eum absque temperaménto :
traditions.KJV: and upon them that have daubed it with untempered [ morter ] ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֹמַ֤ר לָ כֶם֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπα πρὸς ὑμᾶς
traditions.VUL: dicámque vobis :
traditions.KJV: and will say unto you ,

15.english_reference: The wall [ is ] no [ more ] , neither they that daubed it

traditions.WLC: אֵ֣ין הַ קִּ֔יר וְ אֵ֖ין הַ טָּחִ֥ים אֹתֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: Οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ τοῖχος οὐδὲ οἱ ἀλείφοντες αὐτὸν
traditions.VUL: Non est páries , et non sunt qui líniunt eum .
traditions.KJV: The wall [ is ] no [ more ] , neither they that daubed it ;

16.english_reference: [ To wit ] , the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: נְבִיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַֽ נִבְּאִים֙ אֶל יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם
traditions.LXX: προφῆται τοῦ Ἰσραήλ , οἱ προφητεύοντες ἐπὶ Ἰερουσαλὴμ
traditions.VUL: Prophétæ Israel , qui prophétant ad Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: [ To wit ] , the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem ,

16.english_reference: and which see visions of peace for her

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ חֹזִ֥ים לָ֖ הּ חֲז֣וֹן שָׁלֹ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ ὁρῶντες αὐτῇ εἰρήνην ,
traditions.VUL: et vident ei visiónem pacis :
traditions.KJV: and which see visions of peace for her ,

16.english_reference: and [ there is ] no peace , saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֣ין שָׁלֹ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥ י יְהֹוִֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰρήνη οὐκ ἔστιν , λέγει Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: et non est pax , ait Dóminus Deus .
traditions.KJV: and [ there is ] no peace , saith the Lord GOD .

17.english_reference: Likewise , thou son of man , set thy face against the daughters of thy people

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֗ם שִׂ֤ים פָּנֶ֨י ךָ֙ אֶל בְּנ֣וֹת עַמְּ ךָ֔
traditions.LXX: Καὶ σύ , υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου , στήρισον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ τὰς θυγατέρας τοῦ λαοῦ σου
traditions.VUL: Et tu fili hóminis , pone fáciem tuam contra fílias pópuli tui ,
traditions.KJV: Likewise , thou son of man , set thy face against the daughters of thy people ,

17.english_reference: which prophesy out of their own heart

traditions.WLC: הַ מִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וֹת מִֽ לִּבְּ הֶ֑ן
traditions.LXX: τὰς προφητευούσας ἀπὸ καρδίας αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: quæ prophétant de corde suo :
traditions.KJV: which prophesy out of their own heart ;

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנָּבֵ֖א עֲלֵי הֶֽן
traditions.LXX: καὶ προφήτευσον ἐπ᾽ αὐτὰς
traditions.VUL: et vaticináre super eas ,
traditions.KJV: and prophesy thou against them ,

18.english_reference: And say , Thus saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַרְתָּ֞ כֹּה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֗ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρεῖς Τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: et dic : Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: And say , Thus saith the Lord GOD ;

18.english_reference: Woe to the [ women ] that sew pillows to all armholes

traditions.WLC: הוֹי֩ לִֽ מְתַפְּר֨וֹת כְּסָת֜וֹת עַ֣ל כָּל אַצִּילֵ֣י יָדַ֗ י
traditions.LXX: Οὐαὶ ταῖς συνραπτούσαις προσκεφάλαια ὑπὸ πάντα ἀγκῶνα χειρὸς
traditions.VUL: Væ quæ cónsuunt pulvíllos sub omni cúbito manus ,
traditions.KJV: Woe to the [ women ] that sew pillows to all armholes ,

18.english_reference: and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls !

traditions.WLC: וְ עֹשׂ֧וֹת הַ מִּסְפָּח֛וֹת עַל רֹ֥אשׁ כָּל קוֹמָ֖ה לְ צוֹדֵ֣ד נְפָשׁ֑וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ποιούσαις ἐπιβόλαια ἐπὶ πᾶσαν κεφαλὴν πάσης ἡλικίας , τοῦ διαστρέφειν ψυχάς .
traditions.VUL: et fáciunt cervicália sub cápite univérsæ ætátis ad capiéndas ánimas :
traditions.KJV: and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls !

18.english_reference: Will ye hunt the souls of my people

traditions.WLC: הַ נְּפָשׁוֹת֙ תְּצוֹדֵ֣דְנָה לְ עַמִּ֔ י
traditions.LXX: αἱ ψυχαὶ διεστράφησαν τοῦ λαοῦ μου ,
traditions.VUL: et cum cáperent ánimas pópuli mei ,
traditions.KJV: Will ye hunt the souls of my people ,

18.english_reference: and will ye save the souls alive [ that come ] unto you ?

traditions.WLC: וּ נְפָשׁ֖וֹת לָ כֶ֥נָה תְחַיֶּֽינָה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ψυχὰς περιεποιοῦντο ,
traditions.VUL: vivificábant ánimas eórum .
traditions.KJV: and will ye save the souls alive [ that come ] unto you ?

19.english_reference: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread

traditions.WLC: וַ תְּחַלֶּלְ֨נָה אֹתִ֜ י אֶל עַמִּ֗ י בְּ שַׁעֲלֵ֣י שְׂעֹרִים֮ וּ בִ פְת֣וֹתֵי לֶחֶם֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐβεβήλουν με πρὸς τὸν λαόν μου ἕνεκεν δρακὸς κριθῶν καὶ ἕνεκεν κλασμάτων ἄρτων ,
traditions.VUL: Et violábant me ad pópulum meum propter pugíllum hórdei , et fragmen panis ,
traditions.KJV: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread ,

19.english_reference: to slay the souls that should not die

traditions.WLC: לְ הָמִ֤ית נְפָשׁוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא תְמוּתֶ֔נָה
traditions.LXX: τοῦ ἀποκτεῖναι ψυχάς ἃς οὐκ ἔδει ἀποθανεῖν ,
traditions.VUL: ut interfícerent ánimas , quæ non moriúntur ,
traditions.KJV: to slay the souls that should not die ,

19.english_reference: and to save the souls alive that should not live

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ חַיּ֥וֹת נְפָשׁ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא תִֽחְיֶ֑ינָה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῦ περιποιήσασθαι ψυχὰς ἃς οὐκ ἔδει ζῆσαι ,
traditions.VUL: et vivificárent ánimas , quæ non vivunt ,
traditions.KJV: and to save the souls alive that should not live ,

19.english_reference: by your lying to my people that hear [ your ] lies ?

traditions.WLC: בְּ כַ֨זֶּבְ כֶ֔ם לְ עַמִּ֖ י שֹׁמְעֵ֥י כָזָֽב
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ ἀποφθέγγεσθαι ὑμᾶς λαῷ εἰσακούοντι μάταια ἀποφθέγματα .
traditions.VUL: mentiéntes pópulo meo credénti mendáciis .
traditions.KJV: by your lying to my people that hear [ your ] lies ?

20.english_reference: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֞ן כֹּה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֗ה
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Propter hoc hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD ;

20.english_reference: Behold , I [ am ] against your pillows

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֤י אֶל כִּסְּתוֹתֵי כֶ֨נָה֙
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ τὰ προσκεφάλαια ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego ad pulvíllos vestros ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , I [ am ] against your pillows ,

20.english_reference: wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make [ them ] fly

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַ֠תֵּנָה מְצֹדְד֨וֹת שָׁ֤ם אֶת הַ נְּפָשׁוֹת֙ לְ פֹ֣רְח֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: ἐφ᾽ ἃ ὑμεῖς συστρέφετε ἐκεῖ ψυχάς ,
traditions.VUL: quibus vos cápitis ánimas volántes :
traditions.KJV: wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make [ them ] fly ,

20.english_reference: and I will tear them from your arms

traditions.WLC: וְ קָרַעְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔ ם מֵ עַ֖ל זְרוֹעֹֽתֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ διαρρήξω αὐτὰ ἀπὸ τῶν βραχιόνων ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et dirúmpam eos de bráchiis vestris ,
traditions.KJV: and I will tear them from your arms ,

20.english_reference: and will let the souls go , [ even ] the souls that ye hunt to make [ them ] fly

traditions.WLC: וְ שִׁלַּחְתִּי֙ אֶת הַ נְּפָשׁ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם מְצֹדְד֥וֹת אֶת נְפָשִׁ֖ים לְ פֹרְחֹֽת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ τὰς ψυχάς ἃς ὑμεῖς ἐκστρέφετε τὰς ψυχάς αὐτῶν εἰς διασκορπισμόν ,
traditions.VUL: et dimíttam ánimas , quas vos cápitis , ánimas ad volándum .
traditions.KJV: and will let the souls go , [ even ] the souls that ye hunt to make [ them ] fly .

21.english_reference: Your kerchiefs also will I tear

traditions.WLC: וְ קָרַעְתִּ֞י אֶת מִסְפְּחֹֽתֵי כֶ֗ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ διαρρήξω τὰ ἐπιβόλαια ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Et dirúmpam cervicália vestra ,
traditions.KJV: Your kerchiefs also will I tear ,

21.english_reference: and deliver my people out of your hand

traditions.WLC: וְ הִצַּלְתִּ֤י אֶת עַמִּ י֙ מִ יֶּדְ כֶ֔ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ῥύσομαι τὸν λαὸν μου ἐκ χειρὸς ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et liberábo pópulum meum de manu vestra ,
traditions.KJV: and deliver my people out of your hand ,

21.english_reference: and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא יִהְי֥וּ ע֛וֹד בְּ יֶדְ כֶ֖ן לִ מְצוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκέτι ἔσονται ἐν χερσὶν ὑμῶν εἰς συστροφήν ·
traditions.VUL: neque erunt ultra in mánibus vestris ad prædándum :
traditions.KJV: and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted ;

21.english_reference: and ye shall know that I [ am ] the LORD

traditions.WLC: וִֽ ידַעְתֶּ֖ן כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: et sciétis quia ego Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: and ye shall know that I [ am ] the LORD .

22.english_reference: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad

traditions.WLC: יַ֣עַן הַכְא֤וֹת לֵב צַדִּיק֙ שֶׁ֔קֶר
traditions.LXX: ἀνθ᾽ ὧν διεστρέφετε καρδίαν δικαίου ,
traditions.VUL: Pro eo quod mœrére fecístis cor iusti mendáciter ,
traditions.KJV: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad ,

22.english_reference: whom I have not made sad

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲנִ֖י לֹ֣א הִכְאַבְתִּ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγὼ οὐ διέστρεφον αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: quem ego non contristávi :
traditions.KJV: whom I have not made sad ;

22.english_reference: and strengthened the hands of the wicked

traditions.WLC: ו וּ לְ חַזֵּק֙ יְדֵ֣י רָשָׁ֔ע
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῦ κατισχῦσαι χεῖρας ἀνόμου
traditions.VUL: et confortástis manus ímpii ,
traditions.KJV: and strengthened the hands of the wicked ,

22.english_reference: that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life

traditions.WLC: לְ בִלְתִּי שׁ֛וּב מִ דַּרְכּ֥ וֹ הָ רָ֖ע לְ הַחֲיֹתֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: τὸ καθόλου μὴ ἀποστρέψαι ἀπὸ τῆς ὁδοῦ αὐτοῦ τῆς πονηρᾶς καὶ ζῆσαι αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: ut non reverterétur a via sua mala , et víveret :
traditions.KJV: that he should not return from his wicked way , by promising him life :

23.english_reference: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֗ן שָׁ֚וְא לֹ֣א תֶחֱזֶ֔ינָה
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ψευδῆ οὐ μὴ ἴδητε ,
traditions.VUL: proptérea vana non vidébitis ,
traditions.KJV: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity ,

traditions.WLC: וְ קֶ֖סֶם לֹא תִקְסַ֣מְנָה ע֑וֹד
traditions.LXX: καὶ μαντείας οὐ μὴ μαντεύσησθε ἔτι ,
traditions.VUL: et divinatiónes non divinábitis ámplius ,
traditions.KJV: nor divine divinations :

23.english_reference: for I will deliver my people out of your hand

traditions.WLC: וְ הִצַּלְתִּ֤י אֶת עַמִּ י֙ מִ יֶּדְ כֶ֔ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ῥύσομαι τὸν λαόν μου ἐκ χειρὸς ὑμῶν ·
traditions.VUL: et éruam pópulum meum de manu vestra :
traditions.KJV: for I will deliver my people out of your hand :

23.english_reference: and ye shall know that I [ am ] the LORD

traditions.WLC: וִֽ ידַעְתֶּ֖ן כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγὼ Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: et sciétis quia ego Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: and ye shall know that I [ am ] the LORD .
